messages:
maya: Seeing a surge of Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1c since 02:10 UTC. Tiny pods (0.05-0.25 GPU) are being evicted repeatedly. Eviction rate spiked to ~7/min. cc @devin @pavel

devin: Events show `gpu-maint:NoSchedule` taint landed on 3 nodes in rack c at 02:08. That wasn't in the maintenance plan for this AZ. Pending went 22 -> 140 in 8m.

pavel: I ran a label normalization last night; looks like the syncer trimmed rack labels and the maintenance selector matched c unintentionally. My bad.

maya: Pattern is fragmentation cascade: tiny pods scatter, get evicted, autoscaler spins warm nodes that hit taints again -> oscillation and cost spike.

infra-sre: Cost quick calc: extra warm spins ~2 GPU-hrs over 20m. Warm cold-start ~5m. Recommend short-term: remove taints + pause autoscaler.

devin: I'll remove the taints on the three nodes and pause the regional autoscaler, then tail eviction-controller logs. Command:
```
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r2 gpu-maint:NoSchedule-
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r3 gpu-maint:NoSchedule-
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r4 gpu-maint:NoSchedule-
```

ops-bot: Incident bot: Eviction alert acknowledged by devin. Autoscaler paused for ap-southeast1.

maya: Untaints applied. Pending began draining within ~60s; eviction rate dropped to ~0.5/min.

pavel: I'll revert the syncer change, add a strict whitelist for racks, and add a canary gate: only taint if pending_gpu < 15 and eviction_rate < 1/min.

infra-sre: Also adding a fragmentation guard: block automated taints on racks with >50% fractional-pod occupancy. Adding cost-hedge alert to page when warm-pool scale >1.5x baseline for >10m.

devin: Leaving autoscaler paused for 15m. If audits show driver updates needed we'll reapply safely.

maya: Post-incident follow-ups: pavel to fix syncer and rollout, eng-platform to add frag-guard and canary, infra-sre to add cost alert and runbook.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: Eviction rate normalized. Incident logged as 2026-03-23-apse1c-frag-guard-rollback. :white_check_mark:
